title: Bat-Speed vs Exit-Velocity Conversion
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), sprint reps (`sprint:rep`), serve attempts (`serve:attempt`), pickleball rallies (`pickleball:rally`), swim sets (`swim:set`), archery ends (`archery:end`), balance trials (`balance:trial`), and batting reps (`batting:rep`).
app: Sports and skill telemetry from VBT devices, sprint timers, serve trackers, swim logs, archery apps, balance trainers, and batting sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=batting:rep
| stats avg(bat_speed_mph) as avg_bat_speed_mph avg(exit_velocity_mph) as avg_exit_velocity_mph by bat
| sort - avg_exit_velocity_mph
description: Compares average bat speed and resulting exit velocity by bat so equipment and swing efficiency are easier to evaluate.
value: This helps show whether harder swings are actually producing better contact or just more effort.
implementation: Export rep data from a batting sensor or camera system with bat identifier and exit velocity included.
visualization: Scatter plot of bat speed versus exit velocity by bat.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces whether faster swings with a given bat are really turning into stronger contact.
